metrics.name: vric_1000_strict
metrics.definition: 每 1,000 个 ICP 匹配账户中，满足「决策人角色 + email VALID 且非 catch-all + 180 天内验证 + 未 suppression + 有合法依据」的独立人数（STRICT，对外口径）。

numerator.expr: count(distinct canonical_contact.dedupe_key) filter (where contact_point.type='email' and contact_point.status='VALID' and contact_point.catch_all='not_catch_all' and contact_point.verification_method in ('smtp_rcpt','provider_reported','operator') and contact_point.verified_at >= now()-interval '180 days' and coalesce(contact_point.email_type,'other') not in ('role','generic_sales','procurement','finance','support') and canonical_contact.seniority in ('c_level','vp','director','manager'))

denominator.expr: count(distinct canonical_company.id) / 1000.0 filter (where lead.fit_verdict='match' and lead.status <> 'REJECTED' and canonical_company.status in ('NEW','ENRICHED'))

exclusions: CATCH-ALL-RISKY / UNKNOWN / UNVERIFIED / INVALID 不计入
pattern_guess 未二次验证不计入
无 seniority/title 的人不计入
suppression / OPT_OUT / 制裁 hold 不计入
SaaS 侧 suppression 与合法依据条件需双库联合计算（字典 §5.1）

benchmark.note: 行业无统一 VRIC；参照 email fill 80%+ / valid 70–85% / phone fill 40–65%

changelog.note: 首次定义；STRICT/PLUS 分列（字典 v1.0）

metrics.name: vric_1000_plus
metrics.definition: 同 T0-001 的账户集合与人级去重，通道改为 email VALID 或 phone VALID（PLUS，内部运营口径）；输出 email_only / phone_only / both 通道拆分；phone 的 line_type 与抽呼校准未接入前是引擎侧上界。

numerator.expr: count(distinct canonical_contact.dedupe_key) filter (where (email_ok or phone_ok) and canonical_contact.seniority in ('c_level','vp','director','manager'))

denominator.expr: count(distinct canonical_company.id) / 1000.0 filter (where lead.fit_verdict='match' and lead.status <> 'REJECTED' and canonical_company.status in ('NEW','ENRICHED'))

exclusions: phone 的 line_type ∈ {mobile, landline} 且 90 天内验证且季度抽呼校准完成才计入 phone_ok
voip/unknown 线型、pattern_guess 号码不计入
对外承诺只能引用 T0-001（STRICT）

benchmark.note: 无行业统一口径；PLUS 用于电话渠道市场评估

changelog.note: 首次定义；通道拆分随字典 v1.1 强制
